body:
## Problem

The Linux arm64 AppImage can't be built in the release workflow. linuxdeploy (run by `tauri build --bundles appimage`) runs patchelf on every ELF file in `usr/bin`, including the bundled `pacer` CLI. On arm64 that rewrite corrupts the Bun-compiled binary:

- Release dry run for 0.4.0: run 39390391460. The diagnostic verbose run 39392383204 shows `[gtk/stderr] Failed to run ldd: exited with code 1`, then `ERROR: Failed to run plugin: gtk`.
- Reproduced in an `ubuntu:24.04` arm64 container with the release's `pacer-linux-arm64`:
  - before the rewrite: `pacer --version` prints `pacer 0.4.0` and `ldd` exits 0;
  - after `patchelf --set-rpath '$ORIGIN/../lib'`: `ldd` exits 1 and running it segfaults (exit 139).
- The x64 binary survives the same rewrite. I extracted the 0.4.0 dry run's x64 AppImage, and its bundled `pacer --version` prints `pacer 0.4.0`.

0.4.0 works around it by building only the `.deb` for Linux arm64 (#218).

## Fix options

- Keep linuxdeploy away from the CLI: ship it as a Tauri resource or another non-`usr/bin` path that linuxdeploy doesn't process, and resolve it from there on Linux.
- Or repack the AppImage after bundling, putting the untouched `pacer-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` back in place.
- Check whether `desktop.yml`'s arm64 AppImage, which uses a natively built CLI, actually has a working bundled `pacer`, or just packages without error.

## Acceptance

- The release dry run builds `pacer-<version>-linux-arm64-unsigned.AppImage`.
- In an arm64 container, extracting it and running `usr/bin/pacer --version` prints the release version.
- The matrix and docs go back to listing the arm64 AppImage.

Refs #188.
title: desktop: Linux arm64 AppImage corrupts the bundled CLI (linuxdeploy patchelf)
